column1: # omakeb — the session daemons, and who is expected to start them.
# ONE list, read at session start by bin/omakeb-session-daemons and checked by
# test/lint-autostart.py. Everything about these five that used to be spread
# across autostart.conf, lib/units.sh and two toggle scripts is derived from
# here.
# WHY THESE FIVE ARE SPECIAL
# Debian ships a systemd user unit for each and enables it at package install
# time (dh_installsystemduser drops a symlink into
# /etc/systemd/user/graphical-session.target.wants/). A session launched through
# uwsm reaches graphical-session.target, so systemd starts all five, and adding
# an `exec-once` line for one starts a SECOND copy — the "two stacked waybars"
# bug. Upstream Omarchy does start them from exec-once and is right to: nothing
# enables them on Arch. This is a genuine Debian difference.
# But install/80-services.sh has a documented fallback: with no uwsm, greetd
# launches Hyprland directly. That session never reaches
# graphical-session.target, so systemd starts NONE of the five — and for a long
# time nothing else did either, because autostart.conf omitted them on the
# strength of the uwsm path alone. A fallback session came up with no bar, no
# notifications, no wallpaper daemon, no night light and, worst of the five, no
# hypridle and therefore no automatic lock.
# So neither "systemd owns them" nor "we own them" is true of the machine. It is
# true of the SESSION, and only at run time. omakeb-session-daemons asks rather
# than assumes: it gives the units a moment to come up, then starts whatever is
# still missing. Both paths land in the same place.
# COLUMNS
#   name        what to call it in a message
#   unit        the systemd user unit, when the session is systemd-managed
#   binary      what to run when it is not. NB: the Debian PACKAGE for mako is
#               mako-notifier (see packages/desktop.list); the binary is mako.
#   off-toggle  the toggle whose presence means "do not run this one", or `-`.
#               Toggle names are chosen so ABSENT means the default (C3), so a
#               fresh install with no state directory starts everything.
# Whitespace-separated. Adding a row here is all that is needed to bring a new
# unit-backed daemon under the same rule.
# name        unit                  binary      off-toggle
waybar        waybar.service        waybar      bar-hidden
mako          mako.service          mako        -
hyprpaper     hyprpaper.service     hyprpaper   -
hypridle      hypridle.service      hypridle    idle-inhibited
hyprsunset    hyprsunset.service    hyprsunset  -
